description: Get the web-to-app funnels App Store Tracker recorded in a mobile browser for one app or one landing domain, newest first: every screen from the ad's landing page through quiz questions, email gate and paywall or checkout, with each screen's title, text, answer options, the action taken, its screenshot (image_url) and the prices shown. In pricing, period is the plan's billing unit as recorded and raw is the text on the screen: check a price against raw ("4-Week Plan $19.99" bills every 4 weeks, not weekly). Long funnels run to 70+ screens, so one funnel comes per call by default; next_offset reads the next older one. Pass app_id, or host: a domain or a URL, such as an ad's landingDomain or linkUrl from get_ads; a domain also finds funnels on its subdomains (bitepal.app finds quiz.bitepal.app). An empty list means no funnel was recorded for it.

app_id.description: App Store ID of the app (from search_apps)

host.description: Landing domain or URL, e.g. "bitepal.app" or an ad's linkUrl (at most 200 characters); the path is ignored and subdomains match

limit.description: Funnels to return, newest first (1-3, default: 1); fewer come back when they would make the answer too long

offset.description: Funnels to skip, for the next page (use next_offset)

name: get_web_funnels
title: Get web funnels
